meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 读取你的代码库,提炼出其中的业务领域、业务流程和步骤,生成一张可交互的流程图,并在仪表盘中展示。如果之前已有知识图谱就直接从中提取,否则快速扫描代码文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“/understand-domain”或要求分析代码库业务领域、生成领域流程图时触发。

say.text: 运行 /understand-domain 生成领域流程图
say.note: 会输出可交互的横向流程图
强制全新扫描,忽略已有图谱

say.text: 基于已有的知识图谱生成领域图

howto.what_en: Extracts business domains, business flows, and process steps from your codebase and produces an interactive flow graph displayed in the dashboard. If a knowledge graph already exists, it derives from it; otherwise, it does a lightweight scan of the code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say '/understand-domain' or ask to analyze the codebase's business domains or generate a domain flow graph.

say_en.text: Run /understand-domain to generate a domain flow graph
say_en.note: Outputs an interactive horizontal flow diagram
Forces a fresh scan, ignoring the existing graph

say_en.text: Generate the domain graph from the existing knowledge graph
